queries.title: Bitcoin Price January 1, 2026
queries.description: Was Bitcoin (BTC) price above $95,000 USD on January 1, 2026 at 00:00 UTC?
queries.context: Bitcoin experienced volatility in late 2025 and early 2026. This query verifies BTC price at the start of 2026 based on available historical data.
queries.resolution_criteria: Resolution based on Bitcoin closing price on January 1, 2026 at 00:00 UTC from CoinGecko. Use BTC/USD price at that timestamp.

queries.title: Ethereum Price January 2, 2026
queries.description: Did Ethereum (ETH) reach or exceed $3,500 USD on January 2, 2026?
queries.context: Ethereum showed interesting price movements in early 2026. This query verifies whether ETH reached the $3,500 level on January 2, 2026.
queries.resolution_criteria: Resolution based on Ethereum's highest price (high) on January 2, 2026 from CoinGecko or CoinMarketCap. ETH must reach or exceed $3,500 at any time on that date.

queries.title: Total Crypto Market Cap January 1, 2026
queries.description: Did total cryptocurrency market cap exceed $3.2 trillion USD on January 1, 2026?
queries.context: Total crypto market cap is an important indicator for measuring overall market health. This query verifies total market cap at the start of 2026.
queries.resolution_criteria: Resolution based on total market cap data from CoinGecko on January 1, 2026. Use market cap snapshot at 00:00 UTC or daily data.

queries.title: Solana Price January 3, 2026
queries.description: Was Solana (SOL) price above $180 USD on January 3, 2026?
queries.context: Solana showed strong performance in Q4 2025. This query verifies SOL price on January 3, 2026 based on historical data.
queries.resolution_criteria: Resolution based on Solana closing price on January 3, 2026 from CoinGecko. Use SOL/USD price at end of day (23:59 UTC).

queries.title: GitHub Status January 1, 2026
queries.description: Did GitHub experience an outage or incident on January 1, 2026?
queries.context: GitHub is the world's largest development platform. This query verifies whether there was any service disruption on January 1, 2026.
queries.resolution_criteria: Resolution based on GitHub Status page. Incident or outage is defined as any disruption reported on the status page on January 1, 2026.

queries.title: Apple Stock Price January 2, 2026
queries.description: Did Apple (AAPL) stock close above $230 USD on January 2, 2026?
queries.context: Apple is one of the largest technology companies. This query verifies AAPL closing price on January 2, 2026.
queries.resolution_criteria: Resolution based on official Apple (AAPL) closing price on NASDAQ on January 2, 2026. Use data from Yahoo Finance or Bloomberg.

queries.title: Tesla Stock Price January 3, 2026
queries.description: Did Tesla (TSLA) stock reach or exceed $400 USD on January 3, 2026?
queries.context: Tesla is a leader in electric vehicles and autonomous technology. This query verifies TSLA stock price on January 3, 2026.
queries.resolution_criteria: Resolution based on Tesla (TSLA) highest price (high) on NASDAQ on January 3, 2026. Use data from Yahoo Finance or Bloomberg.

queries.title: Premier League Match January 1, 2026
queries.description: Was there any Premier League match played on January 1, 2026?
queries.context: Premier League typically has a busy schedule during the New Year period. This query verifies whether any match was played on January 1, 2026.
queries.resolution_criteria: Resolution based on official Premier League schedule. At least one match must have been played on January 1, 2026 (kick-off on that date).

queries.title: NBA Games January 2, 2026
queries.description: Were there at least 5 NBA games played on January 2, 2026?
queries.context: NBA has a busy regular season schedule in January. This query verifies the number of games played on January 2, 2026.
queries.resolution_criteria: Resolution based on official NBA schedule. At least 5 games must have been played on January 2, 2026 (tip-off on that date).

queries.title: La Liga Match January 3, 2026
queries.description: Did Real Madrid or Barcelona play in La Liga on January 3, 2026?
queries.context: Real Madrid and Barcelona are the biggest clubs in La Liga. This query verifies whether either of them played on January 3, 2026.
queries.resolution_criteria: Resolution based on official La Liga schedule. Real Madrid or Barcelona must have played at least one match on January 3, 2026.

queries.title: New Year Celebration 2026
queries.description: Did the New Year's Eve fireworks celebration take place at Times Square, New York on January 1, 2026?
queries.context: Times Square New Year's Eve is one of the most iconic New Year celebrations in the world. This query verifies whether the event took place on January 1, 2026.
queries.resolution_criteria: Resolution based on mainstream media reports (CNN, BBC, New York Times). The ball drop and fireworks must have taken place at Times Square on the night of Dec 31, 2025 - Jan 1, 2026.

queries.title: Tokyo Weather January 2, 2026
queries.description: Was the temperature in Tokyo, Japan below 10°C on January 2, 2026?
queries.context: Tokyo experiences winter in January. This query verifies the temperature on January 2, 2026 based on historical weather data.
queries.resolution_criteria: Resolution based on temperature data from Japan Meteorological Agency or Weather.com. Use daily average temperature or temperature at 12:00 JST.

queries.title: USD/IDR Exchange Rate January 3, 2026
queries.description: Was the USD/IDR exchange rate above Rp 16,000 on January 3, 2026?
queries.context: Currency exchange rates are important economic indicators. This query verifies the USD/IDR rate on January 3, 2026 based on Bank Indonesia data.
queries.resolution_criteria: Resolution based on USD/IDR middle rate from Bank Indonesia on January 3, 2026. Use official selling rate or middle rate.

queries.title: Bitcoin Daily Volume January 1, 2026
queries.description: Was Bitcoin 24-hour trading volume above $30 billion USD on January 1, 2026?
queries.context: Trading volume is an important indicator of market activity. This query verifies Bitcoin's 24-hour trading volume on January 1, 2026.
queries.resolution_criteria: Resolution based on 24-hour trading volume data from CoinGecko or CoinMarketCap on January 1, 2026. Use total volume across all exchanges.
